Hyperglycemia increases urinary solute excretion, including magnesium, despite low urinary magnesium levels in this case. Magnesium oxide supplementation was discontinued, ruling out acute supplementation as a factor. The low serum magnesium, combined with the diabetic context, supports glucose-mediated osmotic diuresis as the primary cause.
